definitions.explanation: A reason given to justify an action, often not the true reason; a pretense.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}を{口実|こうじつ}にして、{約束|やくそく}を{断|ことわ}った。
examples.english: I used work as an excuse to turn down the invitation.
examples.notes: 〜を口実にして = using ~ as an excuse

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}を{口実|こうじつ}に{会社|かいしゃ}を{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: I took a day off from work using illness as an excuse.

examples.japanese: それは{単|たん}なる{口実|こうじつ}に{過|す}ぎない。
{彼|かれ}は{体調|たいちょう}{不良|ふりょう}を{口実|こうじつ}にして、{面倒|めんどう}な{仕事|しごと}を{避|さ}けている。
examples.english: He's using poor health as an excuse to avoid troublesome work.

examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}を{口実|こうじつ}にして{旅行|りょこう}を{楽|たの}しんでいるのではないかと、{同僚|どうりょう}に{疑|うたが}われた。
examples.english: My colleagues suspected that I was using business trips as a pretext to enjoy traveling.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{口実|こうじつ} has a negative connotation, implying the stated reason is not the true reason. It suggests deception or avoidance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜を{口実|こうじつ}にする (to use ~ as an excuse)
・〜を{口実|こうじつ}にして (using ~ as a pretext)
・{口実|こうじつ}を{設|もう}ける (to make up an excuse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{言|い}い{訳|わけ} - excuse, justification (can be legitimate or not)
・{理由|りゆう} - reason (neutral)
・{弁解|べんかい} - explanation, defense

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
